sources.entry: R-Studio for Mac - Data recovery tool for damaged, deleted, or formatted disks.

summary.name: R-Studio for Mac
summary.one_liner: A data recovery application for macOS that recovers files from damaged, deleted, or formatted disks and partitions across many file systems, including APFS, HFS+, FAT/NTFS, and Linux and BSD formats.
use_cases: Recovering files deleted or lost from a Mac disk
Recovering data after a partition was reformatted
Rebuilding damaged RAID arrays on a Mac
Recovering files from APFS, HFS+, NTFS, or ext4 volumes on a Mac
Recovering files over a network from other computers
summary.what_it_does: R-Studio for Mac scans disks and partitions to recover files from APFS (including encrypted volumes), HFS+/HFS, FAT, NTFS, ReFS, exFAT, UFS, XFS and Ext2/3/4. It offers raw recovery that searches for known file signatures when file systems are damaged or unknown. It can rebuild damaged RAID arrays (levels 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 and nested variants) and can detect RAID 5 and 6 parameters automatically. It also creates disk images, includes a hex editor, previews found files to estimate recoverability, and shows S.M.A.R.T. health attributes.
notable: Supports APFS, HFS+, and many Windows, Linux, and BSD file systems on Mac
Damaged RAID recovery with automatic RAID 5/6 parameter detection
Disk imaging to rdr format and mounting of VMDK/VHD/VHDX/VDI images
Professional R-Studio Technician edition for data recovery workstations
caveats: Paid software; listed from $79.99 on the page
Some features such as E01/AFF forensic formats, tape support, and VMDK/VHD creation are limited to the Technician or T80+ editions
